cohort: Women with singleton pregnancies conceived through sperm donation
finding: The extent of donor sperm exposure did not correlate with obstetrics complications, but double gamete donation was associated with increased risk for preeclampsia, preterm labor, and cesarean section.
mod_finding: Pregnancies following IVF-SD + ED had an increased risk for cesarean section compared with IUI-SD and IVF-SD (adjusted odds ratio [AOR], 2.1; 95% confidence interval [CI], 1.0-4.3).
